anchors.description: White cylindrical drum lampshade of the bedside table lamp at right foreground; left and right silhouette points at mid-height span the shade's outer diameter
anchors.visible_evidence: Both points sit on the bright white cylindrical shade surface at mid-height (v2 crop, original coords 430..640 x 120..370); the horizontal span of the drum equals its outer diameter.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Exact shade model unknown; standard drum shades are commonly 12-18 in (0.30-0.46 m) in diameter.

anchors.description: Round dark wall clock on the left wall; top and bottom ends of the projected major axis give the dial diameter
anchors.visible_evidence: Dark circular dial on the left wall (v3/v4 views), foreshortened into an upright ellipse by the oblique wall; its vertical major axis is the true diameter.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Small object near the frame edge could be a decorative plate; typical round wall clocks are 10-16 in (0.25-0.41 m).
